content.text: Staying in control of play matters just as much when you play at Crown Casino online as it does on a physical gaming floor.

items: **Deposit limits**: players can set daily, weekly or monthly caps on how much can be added to their account.
**Session reminders**: automated prompts that flag how long a session has been running.
**Self-exclusion options**: temporary or longer-term account locks that restrict access to games entirely.
**Reality checks**: periodic pop-ups summarising time spent and amounts wagered during a session.
